periods.label: 完全实力主义的理事长
titles: former world rank third magic knight

appearance.overview: Beautiful adult woman in a suit, often smoking.

personality.summary: Pragmatic, mischievous and severe, but fundamentally fair toward students with ability and resolve.
personality.inner_conflict: She must balance institutional reform with the risks of pushing students into harsh battles.

decision_pattern.administration: removes corrupt staff and changes selection to real combat results

quote_samples: 完全实力主义。彻底施行实战主义。
只要你能在七星剑武祭中获得优胜，不管能力值有多差我都能让你毕业。

habits.daily_routine: Runs Hagun's reform and observes key matches.

formative_events: Reached former world rank third as World Clock
background.pre_story: Appointed chairwoman to rebuild Hagun after poor Seven Stars results.

abilities_owned: World Clock abilities not demonstrated in detail in vol-01

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Gives him a chance to graduate through Seven Stars victory and explains his history to Stella.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Treats her as a student despite royal status and pushes her to learn from Ikki.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Old acquaintance / contemporary who calls her Kuro.

periods.summary: Kurono assigns Ikki and Stella as roommates under her ability-based dorm policy, arranges their duel to settle the dispute, reveals to Stella how the Kurogane family and former Hagun administration suppressed Ikki, authorizes the students' off-campus power use during the Rebellion incident, and continues overseeing the selection battle system that gives Ikki a real chance.

key_events.summary: Explains the mixed roommate assignment and sends Ikki and Stella to duel.
Tells Stella about the Kurogane family pressure and former staff's sabotage.
Authorizes Ikki, Stella, Shizuku and Nagi to use abilities off campus.

periods.label: 理事长的反击准备

status.current: formally appoints Hagun's representatives and names Ikki captain

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Protects his right to fight and recognizes him as the proper team captain.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Advises her about facing parents and not letting Ikki fight alone emotionally.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Old friend; together they recognize Akaza's malice and restrain themselves during the match.
relationships.torajiro-nango: Respects him as Nene and Toka's teacher.

periods.summary: Kurono observes Shizuku and Toka's match with Nene, explains martial techniques, and later deals with the scandal as Hagun's director. She promises Stella that Ikki will not be disqualified by forfeit and arranges matches at the League facility under school supervision. She plans to counterattack when Stella's father arrives, and advises Stella that meeting parents is a joint burden. During the final match she recognizes the adults' dirty scheme but lets the knight duel stand. In the epilogue she names the six Hagun representatives and makes Ikki the team captain because he defeated multiple representative candidates and carried the selection to the end.

key_events.summary: Explains Nuk足 with Nene during Shizuku's match.
Promises to protect Ikki's right to compete and discusses the way out.
Oversees the decisive match and recognizes Ikki's feat.
Appoints the representatives and names Ikki captain.

abilities: time/space repair-like ability shown fixing cafeteria wall

periods.label: 世界时钟处理晓学园事件
periods.occupation: academy director; former professional magic knight
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; International Magic Knights League

status.current: allows Ikki and Shizuku to enter the altered Seven Stars tournament
status.profile_note: Kagami's profile describes her time manipulation and forbidden World Crisis

personality.summary: Pragmatic, sharp and protective; frames the Akatsuki-tainted Seven Stars as still a stage for students to test themselves.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Treats him after Edelweiss and respects his will to continue Seven Stars.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Approves her representative entry after others transfer their slots.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Rushes back with her from Osaka; they split rescue targets.
relationships.edelweiss: Knows her and freezes under her sword pressure; relays Edelweiss's message to Ikki.
relationships.bakuga-tsukikage: Formerly knew him as a respected Hagun director, now struggles to understand his political move.

periods.summary: Kagami's wall newspaper profiles Kurono as the former World Clock, whose time ability and forbidden World Crisis once countered Nene's forbidden technique in the Seven Stars final. During Akatsuki's attack, Kurono races back from Osaka with Nene, senses Edelweiss's sword aura, and reaches Akatsuki's base after Ikki falls. She confirms Ikki is alive, notices the blood showing he wounded Edelweiss, and heals him. In the aftermath she explains the state-backed anti-League motive behind Akatsuki, confirms several Hagun withdrawals, lets Ikki keep his promise by entering Seven Stars, and approves Shizuku's replacement entry.

key_events.summary: Kagami's profile records her time ability and forbidden World Crisis.
Arrives after the duel, heals Ikki, and recognizes that he wounded Edelweiss.
Explains the political aftermath and confirms Ikki and Shizuku's participation.

periods.label: 破军理事长与旧师决裂
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; International Mage-Knight League side

status.current: understands Tsukikage's secessionist aim but chooses not to burden her students with it

relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Former teacher whom she confronts as an enemy after Akatsuki's attack on Hagun.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Hagun captain; she trusts him and later explains his Edelweiss-derived body signal during the Moroboshi match.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Hagun representative whose delayed match becomes a special four-on-one bout.

periods.summary: Kurono confronts Tsukikage in the banquet smoking room and correctly deduces that his real goal is not educational reform but to force Japan's complete break from the League. Although troubled by facing her old teacher, she answers as Hagun's director and believes her students will ruin his plan by defeating Akatsuki. During Ikki's match she identifies that Ikki's freezing is not fear trauma but his body failing to process the new combat signals learned from Edelweiss.

key_events.summary: Discovers Tsukikage's true aim and refuses to tell students the political burden.
Explains Ikki's abnormal state from the stands.

abilities: time control, not directly used here

periods.label: 世界时钟守护观众席
periods.occupation: school chairwoman; teacher; security-capable former top knight

status.current: protects spectators during Stella's match and helps restore the arena afterward

personality.summary: Laid-back but extremely competent, trusting Stella's potential while quietly ensuring civilians remain safe.
fears: spectator casualties from uncontrolled Blazer attacks

relationships.stella-vermillion: Observes that Stella is not careless but has grown used to Nene-level attacks; later helps contain collateral damage.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Speaks with him while he watches Stella after his medical treatment.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Calms her anger at Stella's apparent carelessness by explaining Stella may simply be too durable to need dodging.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Recognizes that Nene's brutal training influenced Stella's threat perception.

periods.summary: Kurono watches Stella's special match from the audience with Ikki's group. When Shizuku thinks Stella is being reckless, Kurono suggests the hits landed because Stella simply did not need to dodge after enduring Nene's training. Later, when Charlotte's shield projectiles fly toward spectators, Kurono instantly uses Clock Drawing to stop time and shoot down every projectile, displaying her former KOK top-class skill. After Stella's Brute Dragon Roar destroys the field, Kurono goes down to help restore the arena, reinforcing the theme that the tournament has experienced knights prepared to contain exceptional student power.

key_events.summary: Protects spectators from stray shield projectiles and analyzes Stella's behavior.
Part of the security framework Stella tests with her full-area blast.

periods.time: Immediate aftermath of Ouma vs Renji
periods.label: 世界第三以冻结时间救下加我

status.current: intervenes medically after Renji's heart is crushed

relationships.renji-kaga: Emergency patient saved by her time-stop treatment.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: The fighter whose lethal blow creates the emergency.

periods.summary: When Ouma crushes Renji Kaga's heart, Kurono immediately jumps into the arena, manifests Ennoia and fires Clock Lock into Renji. By stopping time for his body, she prevents blood loss and oxygen deprivation from worsening the injury until medical staff can place him in a regenerative capsule. Commentators later credit her emergency response as perfect and essential to Renji's survival.

key_events.summary: Uses Clock Lock to preserve Renji's body after Ouma's near-fatal blow.

periods.time: Semifinal day through Ikki's emergency surgery
periods.label: 修复会场并保护学生的世界时钟

status.current: repairs Stella's venue damage, protects spectators from Amane's rampage, and waits through Ikki's surgery

personality.summary: Tired but responsible; she complains about destructive students while still doing the work to keep them and spectators safe.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Repairs the enormous venue damage from Stella's semifinal and tells her to fight without holding back despite the workload.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Orders him to step back during Amane's rampage and later waits outside his surgery room.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Tries to keep her calm during Ikki's emergency and explains why time reversal cannot safely save him.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Friend/colleague whose commentary and orders support spectator protection.

periods.summary: Kurono is exhausted because Stella's Dragon Spirit and final slash wreck the arena, but she accepts that protecting and repairing the venue is the adult knights' duty. During Amane's post-match rampage she orders the knights to suppress him and protect the spectators, then reluctantly accepts Ikki's insistence on handling Amane because the stands need every defender. After Ikki collapses, Kurono checks the video and discovers that a death hand grazed his arm when he saved the referee. She explains that her time reversal cannot safely undo several minutes of damage to a human body, leaving Kiriko as the decisive hope.

key_events.summary: Restores and protects the venue after Stella's destructive semifinal.
Commands staff to protect spectators and suppress Amane.
Identifies how Ikki was grazed and why time reversal is not viable.
